hook.text: A capuchin monkey receives a cucumber slice. She is content. Then she sees her neighbor receive a grape.

buildup.text: Inequity Aversion sets up the incentives, biases, and tradeoffs driving the choice.

discovery.text: Inequity Aversion reveals the behavioral mechanism driving the outcome.

twist.text: Advantageous inequity aversion is weaker. People dislike receiving less far more than they dislike receiving more.

climax.text: Inequity aversion shapes salary negotiations, taxes, and redistribution policy.

punchline.text: Fairness matters so much we sacrifice to achieve it.

quiz.question: What did the capuchin monkey experiment reveal?
options: Monkeys prefer grapes to cucumbers for nutritional reasons
Even primates reject unequal treatment, showing inequity aversion
